title: Jean-Michel Basquiat's birth chart
metaDescription: Jean-Michel Basquiat's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 0.9° Capricorn. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, Mars holds an opposition to Jupiter at 0.1° — close enough to weld drive to expansion. An opposition is the tradition’s tug of war. Both ends are real, and the work is holding them at once rather than picking a winner.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 0.9° of Capricorn is the Sun's exact seat — first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by Saturn in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 22.8° Sagittarius; Venus stands at 14.6° Aquarius; Mars stands at 11.8° Cancer. The tradition reads thought that arrives already in motion from Mercury, attraction that begins as conversation from Venus, effort that surges when it matters from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Mars and Jupiter hold the closest angle here — an opposition, 0.1° wide. Oppositions are read as full-moon geometry — maximum visibility between two needs that share one spine. Behind it, Mars trine Neptune at 1.2°, and Jupiter sextile Neptune at 1.3° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, four placements stand out. Mercury in Sagittarius at 22.8° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Cancer at 11.8° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Jupiter in Capricorn at 11.9° is in fall; Saturn in Capricorn at 18.5° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in earth, 2 in fire, 2 in water, 1 in air by element, 4 cardinal, 3 fixed, 2 mutable by modality. Earth counts what remains: the built, the kept, the finished. Promise weighs less than delivery. Mars, Uranus and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Aquarius into Pisces during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.3° between one midnight and the next. A birth time would settle it in a second; there isn’t one. So the Moon stays unnamed here — the alternative is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact.
